q: Technical analysis studies: 技术分析研究什么？
why: Technical analysis reads the price chart directly - everything important is assumed to be reflected in price.

q: Which is a fundamental factor that can strengthen a currency? 哪个基本面因素可能使货币走强？
opts: A strong economy and rising interest rates
why: Real-world forces such as a strong economy and rising rates change the supply and demand of a currency - fundamental analysis.

q: Sentiment analysis is mainly about: 情绪分析主要关注什么？
opts: How traders feel and where the crowd is positioned
why: Sentiment reads fear and greed - when almost everyone is on one side, the market can be primed to turn.

q: Which tool belongs to sentiment analysis? 哪个工具属于情绪分析？
why: The Fear and Greed index, positioning data and social buzz are sentiment tools.

q: A common way to combine the three types is: 三种分析常用的组合方式是？
opts: Use them one at a time in separate trades
Technicals for entry, fundamentals for direction, sentiment for timing
why: Many traders lead with one and confirm with the others: technicals for the entry, fundamentals for the direction, sentiment for the timing of turns.
